attachments.origin_landmark: humeroulnar head: medial epicondyle + coronoid process (ulna_l); radial head: anterior oblique line of radius (radius_l)
attachments.insertion_landmark: middle phalanges, digits 2-5 (splits to allow FDP tendon to pass through, per digit)

actions: flexes PIP joints of digits 2-5 (prime mover)

functional_compartments.name: Index finger (digit 2) tendon slip
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: median n., muscular branch to FDS (index slip)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: proximal-third endplate band of the index slip's belly -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Index slip's belly is the most independent/deepest, consistent with the index finger's greater independent motor control.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) (describes FDS as arising via humeroulnar and radial heads giving 4 tendons, with variable independence -- deepest for digit 2)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: About 2.11 cm2. Highest spindle abundance in its middle third, at 28.53% of muscle length. The source maps two nerve-dense regions for flexor digitorum superficialis as a whole and does not resolve them per digit, so the same pair is recorded on each of this atlas's four digit-specific compartments. The source's tables label its two targets ulnar and radial, but the row subscripts carrying that assignment were lost in extraction, so the zones are labelled by the upper/lower distinction the prose states explicitly and the target points are labelled only by order.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Zhou J, Jia F, Chen P, Zhou G, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Localisation of the centre of the highest region of muscle spindle abundance of anterior forearm muscles', J Anat 244(5):803-814 (2023), doi:10.1111/joa.14000 -- 24 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and spiral CT localisation

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the volar forearm at mid-forearm, roughly half its length.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Intermediate layer of the anterior compartment -- superficial to flexor digitorum profundus, deep to flexor carpi radialis and flexor carpi ulnaris.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Separate bellies for each digit can be resolved (FDS2-FDS5), which is what allows several to be injected in one needle pass.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: The in-plane technique is preferred here: FDS2, FDS3 and FDS5 can be reached at their points of maximum thickness in a single pass, cutting the number of punctures.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part I -- Distal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(3):107 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17030107
